items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And he and I made a couple of CDs together, one with the big band and another one being a concert in Switzerland. We’d known each other for many years

ctx.x: Now you managed to get Jay McShann and Jake Hanna on this record. I’m not as familiar with Fraser MacPherson.

Fraser MacPherson is a marvelous tenor saxophone player who is from Vancouver. And he and I made a couple of CDs together, one with the big band and another one being a concert in Switzerland. We’d known each other for many years and unfortunately his last two recordings were the ones he did with me, and he passed on. And Jake there, Jake and Jay are buddies.
